desc: Derive the exact minimax recurrence for a state consisting of the unvisited values, the total remaining moves on visited indices, and the player-to-move parity.
Use exhaustive small-state analysis to infer a correct closed-form or one-dimensional criterion, checking \(N=1,2,3\), duplicate values, and all \(A_i=1\).
Prove any sorting/exchange argument or invariant that reduces the subset game to the inferred criterion.
Determine an \(O(N\log N)\) evaluation method and verify it on all three samples and edge cases.
Implement the final Python solution with stdin parsing and required output.
